# OpenAPI structural schema

`openapi-3.1.schema.json` is an unmodified copy from https://spec.openapis.org/oas/3.1/schema/2025-09-15, retrieved 2026-10-04. It validates the OpenAPI document structure; component schemas and examples are additionally checked by `../check_contracts.py`.

Specification: https://spec.openapis.org/oas/v3.1.1.html. The downloaded schema retains its original `$id` and descriptions.
